name: ghcr-tag-sizes
description: Firefox/Chrome extension that shows per-architecture layer sizes for GHCR tags on GitHub package pages.

scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
scripts.lint: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --no-config
scripts.e2e:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node --import tsx test/e2e/run.mts firefox
scripts.e2e:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node --import tsx test/e2e/run.mts chrome
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:firefox && npm run e2e:chrome
